play_short: Learn coding by playing: Scratch, Python, Arduino, chess and quizzes.
description:
DevEducation starts with coloured blocks and ends with real code.

It teaches by doing, not by reading. Courses take a complete beginner from the first coloured block to the first line of real code: Scratch, mBlock, HTML, CSS, Python, Java, C#, Arduino and robotics. Every lesson is made of small steps — drag a block, fix a line, predict what the code will print — so progress does not depend on reading long paragraphs.

Mini games practise the same ideas a different way: chess puzzles, sequencing commands, spotting patterns, matching terms, steering a character through a maze.

Quizzes after the lessons check what stuck, with an explanation after every question. A wrong answer never costs points.

Devi, the robot guide, walks through every lesson. Earn coins while learning and spend them in the in-app shop.

Behind a parent gate: progress, the weekly goal and certificates. No purchase and no external link is reachable without passing that gate.

The app interface is available in 51 languages. Lessons are available in English, German, Spanish and Turkish; in other languages the lessons appear in English.

Using DevEducation requires a Devkom Pro subscription, which unlocks every course and game. The yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial. Prices are shown in the app, in your own currency, before you buy anything.

Devkom Pro is an auto-renewable subscription. It renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and payment is charged to your store account. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your account settings.
